about: Granby is in the Eastern Townships (Estrie), east of Montréal in the Yamaska River valley. It is a bilingual regional town known across Québec for the Zoo de Granby and for a compact downtown under the Yamaska hills. Lakes, ski country, and farmland surround the city. About 69,000 people live in Granby.
